system.requirements: Kneel Behind the Shield (Guard) • Guard +4 Situation (Posture)
system.trigger: You are attacked, before you know whether the attack was successful.
system.description: Requirements Your shield is Raised. Trigger You are targeted by an Attack of which you are aware. +4 Situation bonus to Guard against the triggering attack. Your Speed becomes 0 until you spend an action to rise, and your Arms become Exposed.
